selection_rationale: Account hierarchy should lead because sovereign identity, CRM-safe account joins, corporate linkage, and group rollups unlock whitespace, coverage, routing, and renewal context without requiring model serving first.
agentforce_posture: Agentforce-compatible action and citation contracts only until native runtime is proven in the target org.

modules.business_goal: Show a trusted account group view that reveals parent-child structure, group revenue context, coverage gaps, and why the hierarchy is credible.
mvp_scope: Anchor each account on CRM-safe source_account_id and available sovereign identifier evidence.
Expose corporate linkage edges with relationship type, related entity name, confidence, and evidence.
Roll up group-level revenue and hierarchy completeness where source-backed.
Surface a seller-facing Group Revenue Reveal and coverage-gap validation report.
acceptance_gates: All Account joins preserve source_account_id as the CRM activation key.
Sovereign identifier rows may remain zero until official registry, tax, or filing evidence is present.
Corporate linkage report renders linked Account rows and source-backed relationship fields.
Weighted attribute outputs include source_contributions_json and do not overwrite CRM-safe identifiers.

modules.business_goal: Rank accounts by ideal-customer fit with explainable top drivers and source-bound confidence.
mvp_scope: Build account feature snapshots over firmographic, classification, revenue, and hierarchy attributes.
Produce an ICP fit score with top positive and negative drivers.
Publish score and driver summaries to Data Cloud and Salesforce validation reports.
Capture model, feature, prompt, and source lineage for every score.
open_blockers: Live model training and scoring runtime validation
acceptance_gates: Every score has model version, feature snapshot version, run ID, and confidence.
Top drivers reference source-backed attributes, not unsupported GPT inference.
Scores can be regenerated deterministically for the same feature snapshot.

modules.business_goal: Identify expansion opportunities across linked account groups, products, and uncovered subsidiaries.
mvp_scope: Combine M1 hierarchy edges with product, entitlement, or opportunity coverage.
Create a group-by-product whitespace matrix with confidence and source coverage.
Recommend next best expansion action only when supporting evidence exists.
Route expansion candidates into Salesforce action surfaces.
open_blockers: Product ownership or entitlement source availability
acceptance_gates: Whitespace records are tied to a known account group or related account edge.
Coverage gaps distinguish no evidence from negative evidence.
Action recommendations are source-bound and carry confidence and freshness.

modules.business_goal: Show whether each target account has enough known stakeholders and which roles are missing.
mvp_scope: Resolve CRM contacts and role evidence to account or account group context.
Classify known stakeholder roles with source and freshness metadata.
Identify buying committee gaps by segment or account category.
Draft outreach only as a user-reviewed action, not an automated send.
open_blockers: Contact role and consent source availability
acceptance_gates: Contact/person matching keeps CRM Contact IDs separate from account/entity IDs.
Consent and source restrictions are visible before outreach suggestions.
Drafted outreach is reviewable and traceable to role evidence.

modules.business_goal: Prioritize incoming account intent signals and route them to the right seller or queue with explainable thresholds.
mvp_scope: Normalize intent, web, event, or campaign signals into account feature snapshots.
Apply thresholding and confidence rules before routing.
Publish route recommendation, reason, and freshness to Salesforce or Slack-compatible action surfaces.
Require human approval for externally visible actions.
open_blockers: Real-time endpoint and action runtime validation
acceptance_gates: Routing recommendations carry threshold, confidence, freshness, and source lineage.
No native Agentforce or Slack automation claim is made until the target runtime is proven.
Human approval is required before any externally visible action.

modules.business_goal: Explain which accounts are at renewal risk and what source-backed save play should be considered.
mvp_scope: Combine engagement, support, usage, opportunity, and firmographic features.
Generate renewal risk score and top drivers with lineage.
Create evidence-backed save play recommendations for seller review.
Expose risk and action state in Salesforce without overwriting source system facts.
open_blockers: Engagement, support, usage, or contract source availability
acceptance_gates: Risk scores include model version, feature snapshot, source lineage, and confidence.
Save plays are advisory and require user review.
Data Cloud and Salesforce outputs preserve source system ownership boundaries.
